sites.n: Fábrica Militar Río Tercero explosions

src.t: Poder Judicial de la Nación (Argentina), Cámara Federal de Casación Penal decision in the Río Tercero case (PJN document 206129)
Small Arms Survey, Unplanned Explosions at Munitions Sites (UEMS) map data, 1979-June 2026 (used only as an incident index; its points are city-level and are not used)

sites.kf: Series of explosions at the Fabricaciones Militares plant beside the city. Not an accident: Tribunal Oral Federal No. 2 of Córdoba (Dec 2014) convicted four former Fabricaciones Militares officials of intentional havoc aggravated by death (estrago doloso agravado); the Federal Cassation Court (Sala II) upheld the convictions in Dec 2017. The court linked the blast to concealing illegal arms exports to Croatia and Ecuador.

sites.de: 8 (WFP situation report, 4 Dec 2002); 7 in earlier official counts
sites.dis: damage estimated at US$50 million; residents of San Antonio and Riobamba moved to temporary shelters; Civil Defense fed about 600 people daily
sites.kf: Explosions in the arsenal of the army's armoured brigade inside the city. The Army Chief of Staff said 4 of the dead were inside the unit (3 soldiers, 1 civilian employee). State of emergency declared by President Noboa. The French ministry's ARIA accident record cites a hand grenade activated accidentally as the reported trigger.
